details:
In OpenFGA, the ListUsers API could return incorrect results when it encountered exclusions.

### Preconditions

This applies if your application uses ListUsers to enumerate or enforce access, and the authorization model contains a relation that (directly or through other relations) matches one of these:

1. An exclusion whose subtracted side is itself an exclusion, and whose base also contains an exclusion, e.g., `(a but not b) but not (c but not d)`. This also applies when the base's exclusion is wrapped in `and` or `or`, e.g., `((a but not b) and e) but not (c but not d)`. (Over-grant)

2. An exclusion whose base is a type-bound public wildcard (e.g. `user:*`), combined with `or`, with the result then combined with `and`, e.g., `(([user:*] but not b) or c) and d`. (Over-grant)

3. An exclusion `a but not b`, where `b` can reach the same user in more than one way (directly, through a type-bound public wildcard such as `user:*`, or through several usersets/TTUs), and at least one of those ways goes through a userset/TTU that has its own exclusion, e.g., `b: [user, group#c]` or `b: [user:*, group#c]`, with `group.c: d but not e`. (Over-grant)

4. An exclusion `a but not b`, where `a` can reach the same user in more than one way (directly, or through several usersets/TTUs), and at least one of those ways goes through a userset/TTU that has its own exclusion, e.g., `a: [user, group#c]` with `group.c: d but not e`. This also applies when `a` is used on its own, or inside `and` when it grants the user through a type-bound public wildcard, e.g., `a and f` with `a: [user:*, group#c]`, `group.c: g but not e` and `g: [user:*]`. (Under-grant)

5. An exclusion whose subtracted side is an `or` where one of the branches is an exclusion whose base is a type-bound public wildcard, e.g. `everyone but not ((everyone but not member) or banned)`, `[user] but not ((everyone but not member) or banned)`, or `everyone but not ((everyone but not member) or (everyone but not banned))`, where `everyone: [user:*]`. (Under-grant)

6. An exclusion `a but not b`, where the ListUsers request reaches its deadline (`--listUsers-deadline`, default 3s) and, by then, evaluating `b` either has not finished or has hit an error. (Over-grant)

### Fix

Upgrade to OpenFGA v1.23.0 or greater.

OpenFGA would like to thank @arpitjain099, @manus-pi, @Tan-JunWei, @pb-omer for the discovery and responsible disclosure.
